item_short_desc: Enhance your duty gear with Rothco's Enhanced Molded Handcuff Case, a premium accessory designed for law enforcement professionals. description: Enhance your duty gear with Rothco's Enhanced Molded Handcuff Case, a premium accessory designed for law enforcement professionals. Crafted from heavyweight denier ballistic material, this case offers durability and longevity, ensuring reliable performance in any situation. The high-density foam center and soft lining provide optimal protection for your handcuffs, safeguarding them from damage and wear. With its secure single snap closure, you can easily access your cuffs with just one hand, enabling swift deployment when needed. This handcuff case is versatile, accommodating both standard and link cuffs, making it suitable for various law enforcement applications. Additionally, it fits duty belts up to 2.25 inches wide, ensuring compatibility with most standard gear setups. Whether you're patrolling the streets, conducting arrests, or responding to emergencies, trust Rothco's Enhanced Molded Handcuff Case to keep your cuffs secure and accessible at all times.
